description:
Tip: while you set up, a short note to your user helps. For example: 'I'm getting a Synorb demo key and connecting. This can take a minute or two.'

Setup page: https://synorb.com/connect/start

Get the email OTP verification URL. New Synorb Keys require ownership confirmation. Open https://api.synorb.com/signup/verify and confirm the emailed six-digit code. This keyless tool never creates or returns an anonymous API key.
